channel.title: DegenKit Blog
channel.description: Updates, guides and launch playbooks from DegenKit.

item.title: Creating a Token vs. Adding Liquidity: Two Different Milestones
item.description: A new token cannot be traded until a liquidity pool exists. Learn what a pool is, how the starting price is set, what LP tokens do and what locking or burning them means.

item.title: How to Launch a Token on Base: Wallet, ETH and Your First ERC-20
item.description: A step-by-step guide to creating a token on Base — adding the network, getting ETH onto it, choosing a plain or tax token, and verifying it on BaseScan.

item.title: How to Read a Holder Bubblemap Before You Buy
item.description: Big bubbles are not automatically bad news. Learn what a holder bubblemap shows, what the largest accounts usually are, and how to check them yourself.

item.title: How to Market a Solana Token Without Hype or Shortcuts
item.description: A practical launch-marketing plan for Solana tokens — trust signals first, one official address, listings in the right order, honest promotion and steady updates.

item.title: Robinhood Chain Explained: Add the Network and Launch a Token
item.description: What Robinhood Chain is, how to add it to your wallet, how to get ETH onto it, and how to create a fixed-supply ERC-20 token there with DegenKit.

item.title: Solana Token Metadata: Name, Symbol, Image and Why Locking Matters
item.description: Where a Solana token's name, symbol and image actually live, who can change them, and what locking metadata does — and doesn't — protect.

item.title: Airdrop vs. Multisender: Sending Tokens to Many Wallets
item.description: Same amount for everyone or a custom amount per wallet? Learn when to use an airdrop or a multisender, how batching works on Solana and what to check before you send.

item.title: How to Spot Rug-Pull Risk Before You Buy a Token
item.description: Learn which on-chain signals point to rug-pull risk — authorities, metadata, holder concentration and liquidity — and what a scanner can and cannot tell you.

item.title: Mint Authority vs. Freeze Authority: What Revoking Actually Does
item.description: Two Solana permissions, two very different powers. Learn what mint and freeze authority control, what revoking changes and how to check both.

item.title: What Burning Tokens Does — and Doesn't — Mean
item.description: Burning permanently removes tokens from supply. Learn what changes on-chain, what a burn does not guarantee, and how to verify one yourself.

item.title: Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base or Robinhood Chain: Where Should You Launch a Token?
item.description: Compare the five networks DegenKit supports — token standards, gas tokens, wallets, explorers and available tools — before you choose where to launch.

item.title: How to Create a Solana Token Without Coding
item.description: Prepare your token details, understand decimals and authorities, and follow a clear Solana token-creation workflow with DegenKit.

item.title: How Buy and Sell Taxes Work on a Token
item.description: Understand buy and sell taxes, follow a simple token-flow example, and learn what to check before creating a tax token on BNB Chain.

item.title: Token Launch Checklist: From Setup to Public Launch
item.description: Use a practical launch checklist covering token identity, supply, permissions, liquidity planning, verification and public information.

item.title: Welcome to DegenKit
item.description: Why we built a one-signature token creator for Solana, what "locked by default" actually means on-chain, and what's coming next.
